claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black PS4 console with logo, but do not show the console powering on/booting or any system status.
Photos do not show the exact PS4 model/version or CUH number; only a generic PS4 console appearance is visible.
Photo 0 shows two black DualShock-style controllers.
Witness photo shows a game case/cover with FIFA 21 visible, not FIFA 24.
No Ghost of Tsushima case/disc is shown in the provided photos.
No Spider-Man case/disc is shown in the provided photos.
No FIFA 26 case/disc is shown in the provided photos.

risks.risk: Console may not actually be working (no boot/test shown).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the PS4 powering on, reaching the home screen, and showing the system menu (and optionally loading a game).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/unknown working condition.

risks.risk: Storage capacity and model/version unknown (could be older/slower or smaller HDD).
risks.proof: Photo/screenshot of System Settings showing model/CUH number and storage size (or a clear label photo).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case for value (lower storage/older variant).

risks.risk: Controller health issues (stick drift, unresponsive buttons, bad ports).
risks.proof: A clip showing controller connected and working: moving sticks in the on-screen calibration/test and pressing all buttons successfully.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible controller faults until tested.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (only some cables are visible; other items may be absent).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of everything included: power cable, HDMI cable, charging cable (if applicable), headset, and any other listed accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle (only what’s clearly shown).

risks.risk: Game mismatch/condition risk (photos show FIFA 21, while seller claims other titles).
risks.proof: Clear photo/video of the exact discs/cases included, with the disc label visible and a quick test of the included FIFA title loading.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the photographed game is included and disc condition is unknown.

risks.risk: Region/compatibility and disc scratches (may not play).
risks.proof: A clip of inserting the disc and successfully launching it (and showing it runs past the first screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as disc may be problematic (worst-case for playability).

proof_requests: Send a video of the PS4 powering on and reaching the home screen.
Show System Settings with the PS4 model/CUH number and storage size.
Show a controller test/calibration screen with both controllers responding correctly.
Lay out and photograph all included accessories (power, HDMI, charging/headset if any).
Show the exact game discs/cases included (confirm FIFA title(s)) and record a quick disc launch test.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a PS4 with two controllers and a FIFA game case visible, but the seller’s key claims about being a Slim model and “perfectly working” (plus multiple specific games) are not verifiable from the photos. Without a boot/test and exact included titles, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
